phrases.note: The usual chat abbreviation of besok.
Informal spelling of kemarin.
Chat abbreviation of kemarin.
Chat abbreviation of hari ini.
ntar = nanti, malem = malam, both informal.
Colloquial: 'besok' after a weekday means the coming one, not tomorrow.
Said on a Wednesday, people mean either this Friday or the one after; both are accepted.
'kemarin' after a weekday means the most recent one.
Yesterday or the week before; both are accepted.
In Indonesian, 'malam Minggu' is the night before Sunday: Saturday evening.
The night before Friday: Thursday evening.
English word, Indonesian grammar; common in chat.
tgl is the usual abbreviation of tanggal (date).

phrases.means: the 5th (next month, since this month's has passed)

phrases.note: Day first, as in all Indonesian dates.
Day first: 5 November, not May 11.
Here 'minggu' means week, not Sunday.
malem is the spoken form of malam.
Both words abbreviated, as typed in a hurry.
Indonesian writes the time with a dot.
'Setengah delapan' is half past seven, as in Dutch and German: not 8:30.
Half past two, not three thirty.
'8 kurang 15' is fifteen to eight.
A quarter to eight.
A quarter past four.
It is 10 am, so the next 7 am is tomorrow.
In a chat at 10 am, 'jam 2' means 2 pm; 2 am is not what anyone means.

phrases.means: just after sunset prayer, about 6 pm
phrases.note: A time of day by the prayer schedule, very common.
The dawn prayer time, around 4:30 am.
'9an' is 'around nine'. (Not 10: 'besok' alone already implies the reference time, 10:00.)

phrases.means: the day after tomorrow at 2 pm
tomorrow at 9 am Central Indonesia time, 8 am in Jakarta
phrases.note: WITA is UTC+8; the reference clock is Jakarta (WIB, UTC+7).

phrases.means: tomorrow at 9 am Eastern Indonesia time, 7 am in Jakarta
phrases.note: WIT is UTC+9.
yg is the chat abbreviation of yang.
dlm is the chat abbreviation of dalam.

phrases.text: Oke, ketemu di kantor Senin depan jam 9 ya
Pembayaran paling lambat tgl 20 ya kak
Saya baru bisa lihat unitnya Sabtu sore

phrases.means: the day after tomorrow at 3 pm

phrases.text: Barang dikirim besok pagi, sampai lusa
Maaf baru bales, td malam ketiduran
phrases.note: td is the chat abbreviation of tadi.
Typed in lower case, as most chat is.
'kemarin' here means the recent one: the date is in the past.

phrases.text: Lagi di jalan, 15 menit lagi sampai

phrases.means: every Monday at 8, next on 19 October
